scope: Actual Catalogue stats and production Model hold/release drive world-translated RiderView, both directions at 30/60/120Hz. Reuses unchanged anatomy/support-lock, bone, hoof/joint velocity, toe and shape limits from test_horse_anatomy_v050. Default covers every catalogue horse, fastest/most stable first; --horse-ids selects explicit subset. No repeated steady suite, render capture, OS events or human motion-quality claim.
